scope: Additive A2/B1 practical connected-language and source-use slice. Retained lesson objects and identities preserved.

sources.role: Primary Italian A1–B2 profile context; original situations authored, no examples copied.
Primary communicative reception, interaction and mediation framework; scope informs authoring and is not a proficiency certificate.

identityPolicy: The 58 A2 and 41 B1 baseline lesson objects remain equal to commit7eeeb36. Stable new IDs have no legacy completion inference. All new prerequisite IDs are explicit and validated.
assessedScope: Language targets assess supplied form/meaning/reference in controlled new contexts. Reading/listening targets assess requested source details. Open writing, speaking, actual interaction and mediation remain optional ungraded self-review.
lexicalPolicy: Local editorial sense keys record preparation and encounter links; they are not global dictionary sense entries or acquired-word evidence.
retrievalPolicy: Existing exact-target scheduler remains the delayed review mechanism. New same-visit reserves are fresh repair situations; listed cross-context word encounters are authoring exposure links, not observed delayed retention.

formModels.description: Potere in the conditional: io potrei, tu potresti, lui/lei/Lei potrebbe, noi potremmo, voi potreste, loro potrebbero. Use Lei with an unfamiliar service worker. A specific request tells them what action would help. Potrebbe spostare…? requests rescheduling; vorrei fissare… states the desired appointment. Spostare and fissare are infinitives after the request frame.

An accepted alternative replaces the earlier proposal. Confermo… explicitly confirms; a question about availability does not yet confirm a booking. Confermare present: io confermo, tu confermi, lui/lei/Lei conferma, noi confermiamo, voi confermate, loro confermano.

formModels.description: Avere in the present: io ho, tu hai, lui/lei/Lei ha, noi abbiamo, voi avete, loro hanno. In these completed actions add the stated participle; the subject sets the auxiliary person. Prenotare → prenotato: ho prenotato is a completed booking, while vorrei prenotare is a request to make one.
Vorrei annullare… requests cancellation. Purtroppo softens bad news; perché gives a reason. A number identifies the booking, but never include private account details in a public message.

Keep the constraint in the comparison

formModels.description: A che ora parte…? asks for departure; a che ora arriva…? asks for arrival. Quanto dura…? asks duration. Partire present: parto, parti, parte, partiamo, partite, partono; arrivare: arrivo, arrivi, arriva, arriviamo, arrivate, arrivano; durare: duro, duri, dura, duriamo, durate, durano. Persons in each row: io, tu, lui/lei/Lei, noi, voi, loro.
Più… di and meno… di compare two options. A faster journey may cost more; choose from the supplied constraint rather than assuming one option is best. Diretto means no change on this journey.

formModels.description: An imperfect describes the scene or ongoing wait; a completed passato prossimo reports what changed. Perdere → perso with avere. Aspettare imperfect: aspettavo, aspettavi, aspettava, aspettavamo, aspettavate, aspettavano (io, tu, lui/lei/Lei, noi, voi, loro).

Potere in the conditional: io potrei, tu potresti, lui/lei/Lei potrebbe, noi potremmo, voi potreste, loro potrebbero. Use Lei with an unfamiliar service worker. A specific request tells them what action would help. Posso cambiare il biglietto? asks permission to change it; dove si trova la biglietteria? requests the place to ask. A refund request does not assert entitlement or a provider’s rules.

formModels.description: Name the item first, then use lo for a masculine singular object or la for feminine singular. Funzionare present: funziono, funzioni, funziona, funzioniamo, funzionate, funzionano (io, tu, lui/lei/Lei, noi, voi, loro). Non funziona describes the fault without guessing its cause.

formModels.description: Non mangio… states a food restriction, which may have different reasons. Sono allergico/allergica alle noci states the supplied walnut allergy: choose the ending for the speaker. Asking staff about ingredients does not establish safety when they cannot confirm.

For these ingredient questions, the taught chunks are contiene (one dish) and contengono (several dishes). The full irregular contenere paradigm is not assessed here. Può controllare? requests a check; a reply of non so leaves the ingredient unknown.

Non ho capito says the explanation was not understood. Può spiegare di nuovo? asks the clinician to explain again; può scrivere le istruzioni? requests written support. Repeating a medical term alone does not show that you understand an instruction.

formModels.description: Use trapassato for the action before the past follow-up: avevo, avevi, aveva, avevamo, avevate, avevano + segnalato (io, tu, lui/lei/Lei, noi, voi, loro). A current non ho ancora ricevuto states that the reply has not arrived up to now; it is not proof that no one sent it.

In these requests, a masculine singular document is lo; sending it to me is me lo, and to us ce lo. Combined forms before a finite modal keep the order recipient + object: me lo potrebbe inviare? The attached infinitive alternative potrebbe inviarmelo? is also natural; these checks request the stated pre-verb form.

formModels.description: Imperfect describes the former routine; a completed event changes it, and present describes now. The taught relocation chunks mi sono trasferito/trasferita use the speaker’s gender. Other persons: ti sei trasferito/a, si è trasferito/a, ci siamo trasferiti/e, vi siete trasferiti/e, si sono trasferiti/e.

Per questo marks a consequence of the preceding fact; però marks a contrast. Perché introduces the reason. Do not turn a correlation into an unstated cause: use the connection supplied in the situation.

formModels.description: Secondo me marks a viewpoint; perché states the reason; quindi states its consequence. The preferred option depends on the supplied priority. Preferire conditional: preferirei, preferiresti, preferirebbe, preferiremmo, preferireste, preferirebbero (io, tu, lui/lei/Lei, noi, voi, loro).

Anche se introduces a fact that does not prevent the choice. However, però introduces a separate counterpoint. Keep the advantage and disadvantage correctly assigned; acknowledging one does not mean withdrawing the whole proposal.

formModels.description: Secondo me marks a personal view. A quanto so limits a statement to current knowledge; non ne sono sicuro/sicura explicitly leaves uncertainty. These chunks do not turn an opinion into confirmed evidence. The supplied B1 mood bridge remains separate from evidence quality.

Intendi dire…? checks a familiar partner’s meaning. Intende dire…? uses polite Lei. Intendo dire… clarifies your own meaning. Intendere present: io intendo, tu intendi, lui/lei/Lei intende, noi intendiamo, voi intendete, loro intendono. You can restate the proposed interpretation, but do not put an unsupported new claim in the other person’s mouth.

lessons.outcome: Practise how to explain a repeated housing problem, state its practical effect and propose a specific next step.

assessedTargets.label: Explain the observed effect and purpose
Propose a next step with a deadline

introducedSenses.en: in order to be able to

formModels.description: Perché gives the cause; per + infinitive gives a same-subject purpose. Per poter… adds the intended ability. A repeated fault is a stated observation, not proof of someone’s negligence.

Entro venerdì means no later than Friday; venerdì alone names Friday. Potrebbe avvisarmi? requests notification. A workable proposal names an action and time, while leaving room for the other person to confirm availability.

lessons.title: Negotiate a small group plan
lessons.outcome: Practise how to propose alternatives, respond to a practical constraint and check agreement.

assessedTargets.label: Offer a condition and a fallback

formModels.description: Se + the supplied indicative condition introduces a real possibility; altrimenti gives the fallback if that possibility does not hold. Potremmo proposes a shared action. Do not turn a proposal into everyone’s accepted decision.

Ci servono quattro biglietti says we need four tickets. Once biglietti is known, ce ne servono quattro retains the quantity and refers back to them. Servire present: servo, servi, serve, serviamo, servite, servono; the thing needed controls serve/servono in this pattern. Siete d’accordo? checks whether the group agrees.

lessons.unitTitle: Request help and keep messages faithful
lessons.title: Explain an account problem
lessons.outcome: Practise how to distinguish a displayed error from my interpretation and request practical account help without sharing secrets.

assessedTargets.label: Request help with a clear sequence

formModels.description: La schermata dice… attributes an error message. Non riesco ad accedere reports your observed difficulty. Neither proves that an account has been deleted or compromised. Quote the supplied message exactly; never add a password or private code to the practice response.

Prima di + infinitive places one action before another; dopo aver + participle places it after a completed action by the same subject. The interface instruction reimposta uses familiar tu; reimposti is polite Lei. These are fictional practice instructions, not a real provider’s account policy.

lessons.unitTitle: Request help and keep messages faithful
lessons.title: Relay a decision without changing it
lessons.outcome: Practise how to attribute a practical decision, preserve conditions and separate confirmed information from an unresolved detail.

assessedTargets.label: Preserve a condition and a changed decision

formModels.description: Secondo il messaggio… attributes the information rather than claiming personal knowledge. Confermato means agreed/confirmed; provvisorio means still subject to confirmation. Non è indicato states a missing source detail without guessing.

Soltanto se restricts the plan to the stated condition. Altrimenti keeps its alternative. A later accepted change replaces the earlier proposal. Graded questions here assess faithful wording/reference; relaying an open message remains optional self-review.
